recreation_notes.text:
****************************************************************

        Triple X (Bally 1973)
          Script by Scottacus
              v 1.08
             August 2022

Basic DOF config
  101 Left Flipper, 102 Right Flipper
  103 - 104 Slings
  105 -107 Bumpers
  108 - 113 Upper X & O Rollovers
  114 - 116 LCR Mid OX Rollovers
  117 - 119 LCR Lower OX Rollovers
  120 - 121 A & B Targets
  122 - 123 Outlanes
  131 Right Kicker, 130 Left Kicker
  124 Drain, 125 Ball Release
  127 credit light
  128 Knocker, 129 Knocker and Kicker Strobe
  160 Ball In Shooter Lane
  153 Chime1-10s, 154 Chime2-100s, 155 Chime3-1000s

  Code Flow
                 EndGame
                  ^
  Start Game -> New Game -> Check Continue -> Release Ball -> Drain -> Score Bouns -> Advance Players -> Next Ball
                                                                                                |
                EndGame = True <-----------------------------------------------------------------
***********************************************************************************************************************
